Project: Wire Status Notifications
Type: Story discovery
Priority: High

Description:
Customers need to see a neutral status when wire transfers are pending review. Compliance says customer copy must not mention AML, sanctions, flagged, suspicious, or investigation. The current agent workflow tells customers too much when a wire cannot complete immediately.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Customer sees a neutral pending status for a held wire.
2. Agent sees internal reason codes in the back-office tool.
3. Replayed status updates do not send duplicate notifications.
4. Every status transition emits an audit event.

Comments:
Business owner says Legal has not reviewed final wording yet. Mobile push is phase 2.
